description: The overall average option volume ratio is the average of the transaction-reference and trader-type combination averages.

c.request: Link each sentiment snapshot to its transaction record (`transref` = `transreg`) and that record's trader (`trdref` = `tradereg`), keeping only full matches, and compute the average option volume ratio (`optvolrt`) for each transaction reference and trader type (`tradekind`) pair. Measure each pair's deviation from the overall average option volume ratio (no rows if that's missing). Then, within each trader type, keep only the pairs whose deviation beats the type's average deviation, and note by how much (pairs with no trader type drop out at this step). For each trader type, what are the average option volume ratio, the average deviation and the average excess of those pairs? Averages ignore missing values. Don't round. The overall average option volume ratio is the average of the transaction-reference and trader-type combination averages.
c.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg WHERE s.optvolrt IS NOT NULL AND t.tradekind IS NOT NULL), pair_averages AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) as pair_avg_optvolrt FROM joined GROUP BY transref, tradekind), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(pair_avg_optvolrt) as overall_avg FROM pair_averages), pair_deviations AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, pair_avg_optvolrt, ABS(pair_avg_optvolrt - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg)) as deviation FROM pair_averages), type_stats AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) as type_avg_deviation FROM pair_deviations GROUP BY tradekind), filtered_pairs AS (SELECT pd.transref, pd.tradekind, pd.pair_avg_optvolrt, pd.deviation, ts.type_avg_deviation FROM pair_deviations pd JOIN type_stats ts ON pd.tradekind = ts.tradekind WHERE pd.deviation < ts.type_avg_deviation) SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_avg_optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) as avg_deviation, AVG(type_avg_deviation - deviation) as avg_excess FROM filtered_pairs GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind

d.request: For each (transaction reference, trader type) pair, compute average optvolrt; define overall average as the mean of all pair averages; within each trader type, retain pairs whose deviation from overall average exceeds that type's average deviation; report for each trader type the average optvolrt, average deviation, and average excess of retained pairs.
d.sql: WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT tr.transreg, tdr.tradekind, AVG(sf.optvolrt) as pair_avg_optvolrt FROM transactionrecord tr JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf ON tr.transreg = sf.transref JOIN trader tdr ON tr.trdref = tdr.tradereg WHERE sf.optvolrt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tr.transreg, tdr.tradekind), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(pair_avg_optvolrt) as overall_average FROM pair_averages), pair_deviations AS (SELECT pa.transreg, pa.tradekind, pa.pair_avg_optvolrt, ABS(pa.pair_avg_optvolrt - oa.overall_average) as deviation FROM pair_averages pa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa), trader_type_avg_deviation AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) as avg_deviation FROM pair_deviations GROUP BY tradekind), retained_pairs AS (SELECT pd.transreg, pd.tradekind, pd.pair_avg_optvolrt, pd.deviation, tad.avg_deviation FROM pair_deviations pd JOIN trader_type_avg_deviation tad ON pd.tradekind = tad.tradekind WHERE pd.deviation > tad.avg_deviation) SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_avg_optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) as avg_deviation, AVG(deviation - avg_deviation) as avg_excess FROM retained_pairs GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind

b.request: For each (transref, tradekind) pair with complete transaction-sentiment-trader linkage, calculate the average optvolrt; the overall average optvolrt is the mean of these pair-level averages; compute each pair's deviation from this overall average; within each trader type, retain only pairs whose deviation exceeds that type's mean deviation; for each trader type, report the average optvolrt, average deviation, and average excess-over-type-mean-deviation of the retained pairs.
b.sql:
WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.transref,
    t.tradekind,
    AVG(sf.optvolrt) AS pair_avg_optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  WHERE sf.optvolrt IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sf.transref, t.tradekind
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(pair_avg_optvolrt) AS overall_avg_optvolrt
  FROM pair_averages
),
pair_deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.transref,
    pa.tradekind,
    pa.pair_avg_optvolrt,
    pa.pair_avg_optvolrt - oa.overall_avg_optvolrt AS deviation
  FROM pair_averages pa
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
),
type_mean_deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(deviation) AS type_mean_deviation
  FROM pair_deviations
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
retained_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    pd.transref,
    pd.tradekind,
    pd.pair_avg_optvolrt,
    pd.deviation,
    tmd.type_mean_deviation,
    pd.deviation - tmd.type_mean_deviation AS excess_over_type_mean
  FROM pair_deviations pd
  INNER JOIN type_mean_deviations tmd ON pd.tradekind = tmd.tradekind
  WHERE pd.deviation > tmd.type_mean_deviation
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  AVG(pair_avg_optvolrt) AS average_optvolrt,
  AVG(deviation) AS average_deviation,
  AVG(excess_over_type_mean) AS average_excess_over_type_mean_deviation
FROM retained_pairs
GROUP BY tradekind
ORDER BY tradekind;

a.request: Link each sentiment snapshot to its transaction record (`transref` = `transreg`) and to that record's trader (`trdref` = `tradereg`), dropping snapshots without both matches. For each combination of transaction reference (`transref`) and trader type (`tradekind`), compute the average option volume ratio (`optvolrt`). Take as the baseline the plain average of these per-combination averages, with each combination counting equally. Each combination's deviation is its average minus the baseline (no rows if the baseline is missing). Within each trader type, average those deviations. Keep only the combinations whose deviation is above their trader type's average deviation, and give each one an excess: its deviation minus the type's average deviation. Combinations with no trader type get a deviation too but are dropped at this comparison. Finally, for each trader type, report the type, the average of the kept combinations' average option volume ratios, the average of their deviations, and the average of their excess. Averages ignore missing values. No rounding.
a.sql: WITH joined_data AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg), combo_averages AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt FROM joined_data WHERE optvolrt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY transref, tradekind), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_optvolrt) as baseline_value FROM combo_averages), deviations AS (SELECT ca.transref, ca.tradekind, ca.avg_optvolrt, ca.avg_optvolrt - b.baseline_value as deviation FROM combo_averages ca CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE b.baseline_value IS NOT NULL), type_avg_deviations AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) as type_avg_deviation FROM deviations WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tradekind), filtered_deviations AS (SELECT d.tradekind, d.avg_optvolrt, d.deviation, d.deviation - tad.type_avg_deviation as excess FROM deviations d INNER JOIN type_avg_deviations tad ON d.tradekind = tad.tradekind WHERE d.deviation > tad.type_avg_deviation), final_results AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) as avg_deviation, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM filtered_deviations GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_optvolrt, avg_deviation, avg_excess FROM final_results ORDER BY tradekind;
